title: checkride baseline
description: Schema for checkride.baseline.json — the committed, per-slot set of grandfathered finding keys that `checkride baseline` writes and every run reads. Describes what checkride WRITES: fields are additive under schema_version 1, added in lockstep with this schema, never renamed, removed, or retyped without a version bump. The reader is more tolerant — unknown fields ignored, malformed entries dropped, a newer schema_version rejected whole. See docs/contract.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape, independent of the summary's schema_version. Bumped only for a breaking (non-additive) change; a reader drops a file from a newer version rather than half-reading it.

slots.description: Check name to the sorted set of grandfathered finding keys: the slot (lint, struct, docs, spell, prose, dead, dupes, health) or a config custom-check key, or <target>:<slot> for a target's check in multi-target mode. A fingerprintable slot with nothing to grandfather is present with an empty array; a slot whose adapter has no parser, or whose output that parser can't trust, is absent.

items.description: An opaque finding key built by the slot's extractor: `<file>:<rule>:<message>` for the diagnostic parsers (oxlint, ast-grep, cspell, vale, markdownlint-cli2, rumdl, typos, golangci-lint, staticcheck, clippy, shellcheck, ruff, tflint), with no line or column and the file named from the repo root; category-and-symbol for fallow. Compare and count keys; never parse them.

captured_with.description: Present when a check in slots recorded how its keys were captured: check name to the pin source its tool resolved through when `checkride baseline` captured them, and the version that source named, as the run's summary records pin_source and tool_version. Only `checkride baseline` writes an entry, and the ratchet never changes one. A run whose copy of the tool differs is held back from the ratchet for that check, since a tool upgrade re-keys findings. Absent when no check recorded one.

pin_source.description: The pin source the check's tool resolved through when its keys were captured.

tool_version.description: The version that pin source named, when it named one.
